acceptance.given: A proposed change is evaluated against the TC-D1 scope and ADR-0060 Skill-input v2 contract using the repository Toolchain governance policy and current Skill-input implementation.

oracle.expected: The governance check rejects any proposal redesigning Skill-input v1 or current-pointer semantics within TC-D1, while retaining Skill-input v2 as the governing behavior without weakening it.
forbidden: Accepting a v1/current-pointer redesign within TC-D1.
Replacing or weakening required Skill-input v2 behavior.
Relying solely on assistant text as proof.
oracle.observable: The deterministic governance evaluation rejects the protocol-redesign proposal and confirms the ADR-0060-backed Skill-input v2 contract remains governing.

acceptance.then: The governance evaluation is run against the proposed semantic change and resulting Skill-input contract.
acceptance.when: When evaluating a proposed Skill-input semantic change.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Evaluate a proposal that alters Skill-input v1 or current-pointer semantics; the governance policy must fail closed and reject it.
Evaluate a candidate that removes or weakens an ADR-0060 Skill-input v2 invariant; the governance policy must reject it.

affected_subjects: TC-D1 governance scope and ADR-0060 Skill-input v2 contract
slice_hint.behavior_change: Maintain a deterministic Toolchain governance check that rejects Skill-input v1/current-pointer redesigns and preserves ADR-0060 Skill-input v2 as governing behavior.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Rollback restores prior governance and Skill-input v2 implementation bytes without changing historical Skill-input records, current-pointer data, or schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: Proposal evaluated -> v1/current-pointer redesign rejected -> Skill-input v2 retained as governing behavior; weakening attempts terminate unsuccessfully.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The validator deterministically rejects protocol-redesign input, confirms Skill-input v2 retention, and returns unsuccessful for any v1/current-pointer semantic change or v2 weakening.
